paper_meaning: Changing only the multiplicity of retrieved or elicited expressions leaves the Gate regime unchanged when admissible reasons, standing, warrants, consultation, and task requirements remain fixed.
Evidence that defeats a factual premise may remove a proposition from B_Pi(d).
Any inclusion or exclusion that changes B_Pi(d) is attributable to the declared standing relation, evidential filter, or materiality rule.
Every RESOLVE decision under nonempty B_Pi(d) records a sufficient W_Pi(d) covering the material unresolved conflicts relevant to the commitment.
